subject: ClearHealth compliance add-on: packaging options and concession request
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <contracts@clearhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearHealth compliance add-on details and ask

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — everyone on our infra and security side was impressed with the runtime stats. We have a procurement window in June and need to lock packaging & pricing for the compliance add-ons (audit log retention, HSM seats for KMS, and EU data residency for a subset of traffic).

Ask: can you send an options matrix showing recurring vs. seat-based pricing, and a guidance on how Redwood typically credits implementation/attestation fees (we prefer amortized credits vs. one‑time invoices if possible). We're also evaluating a modest concession (one quarter of audit-log fee credited) if we commit to a 12‑month Dedicated capacity commit.

Attached is the vendor questionnaire and sample retention policy to align on scope.

Appreciate a short turnaround — could you get a first pass by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Infrastructure, ClearHealth
[sara.patel@clearhealth.com]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Legal Team <contracts@clearhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth compliance add-on details and ask

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the questionnaire.

Short answer: yes — we can produce an options matrix for: (1) audit-log retention tiers (30/90/365 days), (2) KMS/HSM as seat licenses vs. per-usage (HSM-seat + per-key ops), and (3) region-scoped residency routing (US default + EU pinned buckets).

I attached a first-pass pricing workbook (ClearHealth_MA_Platform_PRICING_v3.xlsx) and a one-pager on how we typically credit implementation/attestation fees (we can amortize as monthly credits against committed Dedicated spend).

Proposal highlights:
- Audit logs: recurring fee based on ingest & retention tier; pilot concession option = 25% credit on first quarter for a 12‑month Dedicated commit.
- HSM/KMS: two options — seat-based (annual license per HSM instance) or usage-blend (lower seat fee + per-key op).
- Residency: flow-based routing add-on priced per region + small monthly routing fee; we can stage EU pinning for 10% of traffic initially.

Next steps: if you can confirm target retention tier and whether you want seat-based HSM or blended model, I can put numbers into the workbook and surface concessions.

I'll loop in our pricing/finance folks internally to confirm concession thresholds.

Best,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearHealth_MA_Platform_PRICING_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearHealth compliance add-on details and ask -- concession/packaging discussion

Team — forwarding ClearHealth's ask (below) and the pricing draft I shared. Quick summary and questions:

Summary:
- Customer (ClearHealth) is asking for: audit-log retention options, HSM seats vs usage, and EU residency for a subset. They want a concession: credit equivalent to 25% of audit-log fee for the first quarter if they commit to 12 months Dedicated.

Questions:
1) Is 25% credit on first quarter reasonable operationally? Ben, from a pricing P&L view, what cushion do we need to offer?
2) Mina, for HSM we typically price seats at $Xk/seat/year — do you have a recommended blended structure that lowers MA friction but preserves margin?
3) Jonas, any constraint from delivery/ops on staging EU residency for 10% of traffic (pilot) vs full roll-out?

Notes on packaging options I think we should present (pick two to show):
A) Tiered recurring model: clear line items for audit-log ingest and retention + residency + HSM-seat (annual). Pilot credit as 25% of Q1 audit-log recurring.
B) Blended commit model: lower recurring audit-log price in exchange for a 12-month commit with upfront/soft-commit credits amortized monthly + one-time implementation fee offset.

I suggest we push for amortized credits vs an upfront waiver — better GAAP and predictable revenue. If we can't accept 25% raw, propose 15% + 1 month free of retention for Early Adopter.

I pulled key lines from the workbook into the attached tab. Please reply with quick thumbs before I send final numbers to ClearHealth.

--Aditya

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearhealth.com> wrote:

Date: 2027-05-27T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: ClearHealth: pricing bundle & concession counterproposal

Hi Sara (and contracts team),

Thanks for the patience — we've discussed internally and put together a counterproposal attached. Key points below:

1) Audit-log retention (tiers):
   - 30 days: $0.02/GB/mo
   - 90 days: $0.05/GB/mo
   - 365 days: $0.12/GB/mo
   Pilot concession: 20% credit on audit-log charges applied to the first 3 months (applied as monthly credits) if ClearHealth signs a 12‑month Dedicated commit (vs the 25% requested).

2) HSM/KMS:
   - Seat license: $18,000 per HSM seat/year (recommended for high-sensitivity keys).
   - Blended option: $6,000 per seat/year + $0.00012 per key-op. We recommend blended for pilots to reduce upfront.

3) Residency:
   - EU pinning: $3,000/mo for region routing + $0.01/GB egress within EU pinned traffic. We can stage at 10% traffic initially and expand by mutual milestone.

4) Implementation & attestation:
   - Standard SOW fee: one-time $35,000. We will amortize the SOW as monthly credits across the first 6 months of the term if you prefer (we show both options in the workbook).

We attached: ClearHealth_MA_Platform_PRICING_v3.xlsx (numbers tab) and SOW_ClearHealth_HIPAA_Residency_v1.pdf (SOW draft). Also included a short sample audit-log file to demonstrate format.

Ask: please review the attached deck and confirm which model you prefer (Tiered recurring vs Blended commit). If legal prefers seat-only HSM, flag that and we'll adjust numbers — otherwise the blended seat + per-op is lower friction for initial rollout.

If that looks okay, we'll issue a formal amendment and a 30‑day pilot order to capture the 12‑month commit and credits.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30‑minute sync if helpful.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: ClearHealth_MA_Platform_PRICING_v3.xlsx (xlsx), SOW_ClearHealth_HIPAA_Residency_v1.pdf (pdf), evidence_auditlog_sample.txt (txt)
